name: Against Lord Shalzaru
summary: At Feathermoon Stronghold, Latronicus Moonspear asks you to stop Lord Shalzaru and recover the relic he found.

sections.title: The Naga Chain of Command
sections.body: Latronicus Moonspear has fresh reports on the naga chain of command. Royals give orders among their ranks. Lord Shalzaru is one of the crueler royals.

sections.title: An Odd Relic
sections.body: Scouts say Lord Shalzaru uncovered an odd relic while the naga dug in a cave on the Isle of Dread. The cave lies over the water, south of the main ruins. Latronicus wants you to stop Shalzaru and end the dig. Then bring the Mysterious Relic to Feathermoon Stronghold for study.

sections.title: When It Is Done
sections.body: Lord Shalzaru's fall may leave the naga in disarray for a while, Latronicus believes, perhaps for good. He thinks the threat is now more under control than ever. He has one more thing to ask of you.

faq.answer: Lord Shalzaru is one of the crueler naga royals. Royals give the orders among the naga ranks.
Scouts place Lord Shalzaru's dig in a cave on the Isle of Dread, over the water and south of the main ruins.
The Mysterious Relic is an odd object Lord Shalzaru uncovered while the naga were digging. Latronicus wants you to bring it to him for study.

faq.q: Where do I deliver the relic?
faq.answer: Bring the relic to Latronicus Moonspear at Feathermoon Stronghold.
